scene_prompt: Modern community hall exterior. A stubborn adult visitor keeps pushing a clearly shut wooden door secured by an obvious exterior horizontal bolt and large plain padlock. He turns face away and covers one ear with one hand, the other palm stubbornly pushes the immovable locked door. A patient guide points out the adjacent wide-open doorway a few steps to right, through which another visitor is easily walking into the SAME hall. Both doorways visible on same front wall, same interior visible through open one. The stubborn visitor ignores obvious practical guidance and keeps futilely repeating wrong action. Gentle humor, no anger or violent forcing, no injury, no caricature of disability. Natural anatomy five fingers, feet planted, lock bolt hinges and door structure mechanically sound. No readable text sign labels brands letters numerals watermarks. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored pencil warm ivory paper.
alt: 入口旁明明有敞開的門，嚮導也指著提醒，一名訪客卻轉頭摀耳不聽，仍固執地推著上閂鎖住的門。
